summary: From 20 base records, two distinct Raleigh retail refinance opportunities qualify: Elm Square 1 (R6968 / entity ELM-REF-63521, executed maturity 2027-01-15, original principal $8,640,000) and Elm Point 3 (R7631 / entity ELM-REF-53828, executed maturity 2027-03-15, original principal $9,936,000), ranked by confirmed maturity ascending. R4437 is a duplicate of R6968 (same entity) and was consolidated rather than counted twice. All other records failed on scope (Seattle market; Office asset type per executed amendments U-R3478-5, U-R9233-4, U-R5893-7, U-R2630-6, or base Office in R3427), debt status (released R9095; status_unknown R4755), maturity evidence (unconfirmed R2801, inferred R9201, out-of-window R8058, executed extension to 2028-09-30 in U-R1927-1), or people evidence (stale ownership R6909, former employee R1548, registered agent only R4641, property manager only R2376). R7798 was excluded solely because its source was published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff. Outstanding balances are unknown (null) for every record — only original principal is published — so no loan-to-value or payoff sizing is supported. No SPV-to-parent mappings were present in the packet.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null for all 20 records; original principal is reported as such and must not be read as current payoff.

R7631 carries a recorded release (U-R7631-2) published and effective 2026-09-10. Under the stated cutoff rule this post-cutoff evidence does not override the base extract, but the loan is very likely no longer active in reality; verify before outreach.

R7798 (Elm Crossing 18) may well qualify on the merits (active loan, executed 2027-04-15 maturity, current Director of Finance) but its only source is published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff, so it was excluded for evidence timing rather than substance.

Owner and contact verification for the shortlisted records both rest on a single 2026-08-10 combined evidence item (note owner confirmation plus team page); no independent second confirmation of contact employment is available except for entity ELM-REF-63521, where R4437 duplicates the same underlying record.
Emails are taken as published_business values in the extracts; no enrichment, validation or deliverability check was performed.

Asset-type reclassifications to Office arrive via 'executed_amendment' documents, an unusual instrument for asset type; they were applied as controlling per the packet rules, which materially reduced the eligible pool.
No lender, interest rate, DSCR, occupancy or valuation data is supplied, so refinance need and sizing cannot be assessed.
